task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to attempt to move west. Then, attempt to go south. And then, go east. And then, retrieve the passkey from the floor of the cubicle. Alright, thanks!
description:
You find yourself in a bedchamber. An ordinary one.

You make out an opened locker nearby. The locker is empty, what a horrible day! You scan the room for a shelf, and you find a shelf. The shelf is normal. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You can see a desk. The desk is normal. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is an open gateway leading west. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going north. There is an unguarded exit to the south.
